messages:
cory: Heads-up: thinking about making our OTLP exporters SLA-aware so retries/backoff respect customer quotas and console SLOs. Want input before drafting an RFC.

maya: By SLA-aware do you mean we should throttle retries when tenant is near quota or when their latency SLO is in danger? Examples would help.

cory: Two parts: (1) exporter-level decisions — if a tenant is hitting quota or backend is returning 429s, back off more aggressively for that tenant to avoid blowing budgets. (2) routing/fallback — if primary sink (tempo) is overloaded, route to cheaper fallback (jaeger/honeycomb) or reduced-sampling sink to keep traces flowing.

sam: Agree on both. Need a clear metric surface so we can debug decisions: emitter metric like `exporter_retry_decision_total{tenant, sink, decision="backoff|retry|fallback", reason="quota|throttle"}`. Console should expose a heatmap of tenants with high backoff rates.

olivia: For Tempo specifically, we saw downstream 429 storms where naive retries make things worse. Exponential backoff + tenant-aware max attempts helped. Pseudocode:

```
max_attempts = tenant_policy.max_attempts
if tenant_quota_remaining < threshold: max_attempts = min(max_attempts, 1)
for attempt in range(max_attempts):
  resp = send_to_tempo(spans)
  if resp.ok: break
  if resp.status == 429: sleep(exp_backoff(attempt) + jitter())
  else: break
```
Also emit `retried_spans_count` so billing and quotaing can consider retries.

cory: Good point about billing — we must not double-bill customers for retries they didn't cause. Quota accounting should deduct tokens only once at acceptance, or we need a retry-token accounting model.

dev-bot: RFC draft created: rfc/452 "exporter-sla-aware-retry-and-quota-integration" (link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/452) :robot_face: 

juan: UI thought: add tenant setting "Failover policy" with options: aggressive-retry, conservative-retry, immediate-fallback. Show estimated token-cost impact and historical fallback count in tenant detail page. Quick mock: dropdown + small sparkline.

maya: Also: quota meter in console must include a line for "backend retries" vs "client-submitted tokens". Otherwise support will get confused. And alerting: if exporter-level backoffs spike for a tenant, page ops.

sam: Actionable items:
- sam: own metric naming + prometheus/OTLP schema + dashboard panel.
- olivia: open tempo-exporter PR with tenant-aware backoff and `retried_spans_count`.
- juan: add mockups for failover policy and cost estimate UI.
- cory: coordinate RFC and add decision matrix for routing fallback order.

cory: timeline? aim for prototypes this sprint, RFC next week. If we can get metrics + PR in ~5 days we can iterate in staging.

maya: +1. Also we should add a small experiment: for 10% of tenants try immediate-fallback policy to measure impact.

cory: Perfect — can someone own the experiment config? (Assign to sam?) :thumbsup: 

sam: I'll own the experiment config and dashboards. Planning a short spike today.

cory: Great. Thanks everyone — I'll add these action items to the RFC and ping folks when the PR is up.
